hg-ge-houses-100k.label: home.ge Georgia houses ≤ €100k
hg-ge-houses-100k.note: home.ge EN house-for-sale search /en/saxlebi-agarakebi/search-results.html with the site's own GET filter f[Category_ID]=88 (House For Sale) and f[price][to]=100000&f[price][currency]=euro. Verified 2026-09-19: 84 ads / 2 pages (48 per page). Query-string price filter works (unfiltered sale category is 7 pages). Display currency is USD by default (70,000.00 $ / JSON-LD USD); we convert at the documented 0.85 EUR/USD so $110k cards stay under the EUR skip. First anonymous GET is an empty 200 + session cookie (Refresh: 0) — Fetcher retries. Pagination is /search-results/indexN.html (page 1 omits it). robots.txt Allow: /; ?sort_by= is an indexer rule — do not sort that way. Georgia: foreigners can own non-agricultural freehold (houses, household plots); agricultural land is generally restricted. Seed is houses only, not /miwis-nakveti/ land.
